meta.name: lending-hold-expiry
meta.comment: Releases a hold nobody collected and offers the item to the next borrower.

meta.name: lending-loan-approval
meta.comment: Approves a loan: checks the borrower, reserves the copies, waits for a librarian, records the loan and tells the borrower.

meta.name: lending-loan-renewal
meta.comment: Renews a borrower's loans: settles any late fee first, then extends every loan and asks for approval again where a loan was flagged.

meta.name: lending-overdue-sweep
meta.comment: Finds the loans past their return date and reminds each borrower.
